searchText: <unnawut> I just realized we don't have any metrics on pq signature signing & verification yet so I'm submitting as a PR to leanMetrics here: https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanMetrics/pull/6 <unnawut> Also since signature size is a concern should we also track network throughput as well? <salakhiev> If needed we can measure attestations propagation in devnet1 for different number of validators and different bandwidths using shadow <katya_rz> re: **@unnawut** > I just realized we don't have any metrics on pq signature signing & verification yet so I'm submitting as a PR to leanMetrics here: https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanMetrics/pull/6 Does it make sense to measure the size in bytes of a signed attestation? I think it's also good to know <salakhiev> I think it has a fixed size. So probably having a metric for that is overkill <katya_rz> re: **@unnawut** > Also since signature size is a concern should we also track network throughput as well? This one is tricky but important. What comes into my mind is outbound/inbound gossip messages size. But probably not enough. Can we measure it using libp2p metrics/methods? @salakhiev you might know more about it. <salakhiev> We do snappy compression for all messages (before gossip) <katya_rz> re: **@salakhiev** > We do snappy compression for all messages (before gossip) When receiving messages, there will be duplicated ones as well. For throughput we need to measure all of them. <corcoranwill> https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1828 <corcoranwill> Agenda issue for Weds call (summarizing the previous call). Please add any discussion items or open PRs you would like to discuss to the comments below the issue. Thanks

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <unnawut> I just realized we don't have any metrics on pq signature signing & verification yet so I'm submitting as a PR to leanMetrics here: https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanMetrics/pull/6

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <unnawut> Also since signature size is a concern should we also track network throughput as well?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <salakhiev> If needed we can measure attestations propagation in devnet1 for different number of validators and different bandwidths using shadow

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<katya_rz> re: **@unnawut**
> I just realized we don't have any metrics on pq signature signing & verification yet so I'm submitting as a PR to leanMetrics here: https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanMetrics/pull/6
Does it make sense to measure the size in bytes of a signed attestation? I think it's also good to know

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <salakhiev> I think it has a fixed size. So probably having a metric for that is overkill

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<katya_rz> re: **@unnawut**
> Also since signature size is a concern should we also track network throughput as well?
This one is tricky but important. What comes into my mind is outbound/inbound gossip messages size. But probably not enough. Can we measure it using libp2p metrics/methods? @salakhiev you might know more about it.

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <salakhiev> We do snappy compression for all messages (before gossip)

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<katya_rz> re: **@salakhiev**
> We do snappy compression for all messages (before gossip)
When receiving messages, there will be duplicated ones as well. For throughput we need to measure all of them.
